description: Returns the details of an offer from Canarias.com's own fleet: car, priced extras, terms, full insurance with no excess included (drivers aged 23 or over, subject to terms) and deposit. Each result includes precioOnline (advance online payment, 10% online payment discount; null when only pay at pickup is available), precioEnOficina (standard rate, paid at pickup), ahorroOnline (precioEnOficina minus precioOnline, computed by the engine) and, when available, resumenPrecio (ready-made text with both prices). Online payment is optional; prepaid rentals can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup, with a refund. The deposit guarantees the car is returned on time.
name: ver_oferta
title: View offer details
